title: Reject single-vector Lavapipe workgroup lowering:16/22 benefit conditions
body:
Closed as a rejected private compiler experiment: **16/22 original benefit conditions passed** (3/4 whole calls,13/16 inclusive stages,0/2 provisioning-inclusive API windows). This does not resolve #44.

The one fixed A1/B1/B2/A2 trial retained three original internal repeats per slot, all inputs, scene/work/count budgets, governors, cache-disabled policy, thresholds and assertions. Forward legacy/modern whole-call changes were +21.14345052955971% / -4.396774808221876%; reverse were +18.73349101279109% / +15.332478191609765%. Forward/reverse inclusive API changes were -83.39761121743761% / -28.686096493579942%. Three forward-modern inclusive stages also failed. An independent Decimal/raw-XML implementation agrees with all22 decisions. No pooling, cost subtraction, retry or adoption.

The distinct premise was observed in ordinary called driver code. Authenticated Mesa25.2.8 and existing GCC14/LLVM21.1.8 built two matched private providers. The baseline relink is byte-identical to its original build. Exactly lp_state_cs.c.o differs between the two complete llvmpipe archives. The unchanged104040-byte Transport SPV runs through an eight-lane/four-function coroutine baseline or a sixteen-lane/one-function candidate, retaining all9 memory fences. Both actual public factory captures request the same55 feature values and extension policy; no subgroup/property/feature override, global installation, shader, arithmetic or program change occurred. Candidate Transport machine text is981524 bytes versus879802 aggregate baseline function bytes; stack/code growth alone does not establish the measured regression's cause.

All174268 original independent arithmetic records passed on the candidate64-lane fallback. The additional16-lane shared-memory permutation/atomic-mask/count diagnostic passed on both providers, including48 preserved output-tail words. Its initial log mislabels the total word count as complement-initialized; the preserved source and explicit scope correction distinguish522804 complement-initialized arithmetic words from48 separately initialized tail canaries. Complete terminal comparisons remain valid; no workload was repeated.

Original control8 passed under its unchanged300s/4GiB/2GiB-reserve owner in135.193077698s. All four trial slots passed correctness and ownership. Read-only admission verifies51 markers,54 executed-module joins and32 complete unmasked readback digests per instance, equal across control8 and all4 slots. The public55-feature captures, actual resident provider mappings, original observer/API scopes, ordinary optimized LLVM/JIT ELF/live bytes, complete XML/stdout, owners, immutable inputs, official source tar and reconstruction of11092 regular files plus10 symlinks are preserved.

The remaining7 controls and original cold frame were not run for this rejected version. Sirius application code remains6d2af336, PR62 remains draft at that source and main remains5e706073. Full Mandatory, scientific, native-window/physical-frame, external-provider and installed-release qualification remain open.

[Complete pushed source/build/providers/JIT/arithmetic/control8/sole-ABBA and rejection evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/4b44742d536f8f8fffecac25101e94ec4475e890/attestations/qualification/8c2be67d/lavapipe-vector-workgroup-rejected). The private source/helper branch ends at9d1a58c7; runtime source is8c2be67d and the provider build source is5df02b11. System libraries/tools are frozen identities, not binary backups.
